response.justification: Strong, deeply experienced generalist engineer (15+ years, staff-level titles, BS in CS) with genuine strengths in TypeScript/Node, distributed low-latency systems, testing discipline, and public teaching/workshops — all relevant to a customer-facing forward-deployed role. However, the resume does not demonstrate the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI solutions: GenAI exposure appears limited to roughly a year of MCP code generators and agent tooling at re:cinq. There is no evidence of Python, RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks, and cloud/data-pipeline experience is present but not AI-centric. Worth a screening call given the recent MCP/agentic work and strong engineering fundamentals, but this is a significant stretch for a Staff GenAI hire.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems across web, backend, mobile, and embedded; staff-level scope
Recent hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling, plus TypeScript/Node and AWS CDK depth
Proven mentoring, consulting, and public-speaking/workshop track record — strong fit for customer-facing delivery
concerns: AI/GenAI experience is roughly 1 year, far short of the 8+ years of production AI required
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent framework work
Python absent from skills; data-pipeline and large-scale cloud AI architecture experience not evidenced

key_factors.factor: Missing core stack (Python, RAG, vector DBs, agent frameworks)
Senior engineering breadth, MCP/agent tooling, and mentoring/customer-facing skills
